tactics.label: hidden_ad
tactics.reason: The link in the description pays the creator when you buy, and the video never says so.

reality_check: This video has been up for 797 days, and it hides the fact that it glorifies violence. It is built to make you feel excitement and shock. If it got to you, that is the video working, not something wrong with you.

concern.evidence: bikers are attacked by car drivers in this video you saw a car driver clearly trying to run over a biker
concern.reason: The video shows bikers facing aggressive drivers, and the channel earns from every view. Watch for the moments when fights break out: it’s intense and chaotic.
